g.text: Backend ready (mistral.rs CPU, Qwen3-0.6B) and gateway up
Completion answered through the gateway and logged
cmd: just gateway-candle-check | pass: prints 'backend: mistral.rs (Candle) cpu serving Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B' and the gateway answers HTTP
cmd: just gateway-candle-check | pass: prints 'request-ok: http=200 curl_rc=0 completion_tokens=<n>' with only 200 records
cmd: just gateway-candle-check | pass: prints 'request-failed: http=5xx curl_rc=<non-zero>' with only 5xx records (no silent failover)
cmd: just gateway-candle-check | pass: prints 'PASS gateway-candle' and podman ps -a lists no wattson-candle-backend or wattson-gw-candle
